Name: QTYVALIDATION
Description:
QTYVALIDATION

Generic process step to cater for overall quantity validation. Checking for decimal, integer, big integer, varchar inputs. Also caters for checking if input is a Document, Barcode, Location, Code or Alias Code
Also caters for a maximum value, based on value defined in StaticData

Additional validation can also be used within the prescript, such as:
If Code UOM is each - call integer check, if Code UOM is KG - call decimal check.
